patch_description: A completely different algorithm: instead of soft-minimum annealing, I use a physics-style force-balance relaxation (each pair is connected by a nonlinear spring: pairs shorter than the current min-distance get repulsive forces, pairs near the diameter get weak attractive forces) combined with projection back to dmax=1 after each step. This "Thomson-like" relaxation with diameter pressure naturally flows toward equal-distance packings. Then a final exact constrained SLSQP polish (maximize t s.t. t² ≤ d²ij ≤ 1) locks the configuration to a true local optimum of the exact squared ratio. Structured seeds cover distinct geometric families (staggered heptagon rings, icosahedron+poles, cuboctahedron+poles, rhombic-dodecahedron-like, Fibonacci sphere), and a degenerate-basin check reallocates effort. The approach avoids the softmax-ratio plateau because the force model targets distance *equality* directly rather than a smoothed ratio objective.
